system.description: A Lasombra Court of Blood has ruled against you, granting a rival permission to hunt you for Amaranth. You do not necessarily know who has been given license to seek your destruction, nor the exact conditions the court set upon the hunt, but the sanction stands until your hunter succeeds, fails permanently, or the court rules otherwise. Even defeating one would-be diablerist is no guarantee a second or third will not eventually come. The point cost varies with the strength of your hunter, the severity of the court's conditions, and whether you have even been informed of your own condemnation — work out the specifics with your Storyteller.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book One: Magisters
